bids.notes: Two dead oaks behind the house — the two closest to the house, right behind the school in Colcord. All work is done from a lift; no climbing on dead trees. Prices include cutting, clean-up, and haul-off. This quote: both dead oaks trimmed back off the house, $1,400. Priced separately: the big dead oak over the carport trimmed $950, the second dead oak trimmed $600. Or remove instead: big dead oak $2,250, second dead oak $1,650, both removed $3,400. Optional add-on on removals: stump grinding $175 per stump (stumps cut flush included in removal prices).
